description: Scenario tests for remotion-video-edit. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied.

evals.name: promo-reel-asks-first
evals.input: Remotion ile ürünüm için 15 saniyelik bir tanıtım reel'i yap.
expect: asks the section 1 questions (topic and flow, SFX source, animation references, file paths, spoken recording) in one message before writing code
does not assume folder paths for SFX, assets or the Remotion project
writes a scene-by-scene storyboard with timings, animation and SFX per scene and waits for approval before coding

evals.name: silence-and-retake-cut
evals.input: Elimde 2 dakikalık konuşmalı bir kayıt var, boşlukları ve tekrar eden cümleleri kes.
expect: asks where to install the Python venv and the model, and whether a faster-whisper model is already downloaded
pins the transcription language instead of relying on auto-detect
keeps the last complete clean take of a repeated sentence and removes earlier attempts
reports new duration, each removed range with its words and reason, conflicts, and self-notes
applies no audio processing to the user's voice beyond cuts

evals.name: render-only-after-approval
evals.input: Storyboard güzel, kodu yaz ve hemen render al.
expect: builds the project and opens a Remotion Studio preview first
checks key frames as stills (safe area, Turkish glyphs, shader visible) before asking for final approval
renders only after explicit final approval and verifies 1080x1920, 30 fps, duration and peak below 0 dB
states that it cannot listen to the audio

evals.name: no-publishing
expect: does not publish or schedule from this skill
routes the caption to caption-writer and publishing to instagram-reels-publishing or scheduling-and-queue with explicit confirmation
